jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY . The Role We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion. This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Guardian
jobs.description: About the Team The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm. Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products. jobs.description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. jobs.title: Senior Hub Developer
jobs.description: We're looking for a developer to grow Ember's network of charging hubs. You'll find the sites, take them through legals and planning, manage the build and energise them. How you work and think matters more to us than which industry you've worked in. You think clearly, can run several projects at once and are as at home on a site as behind a desk. About Ember We're building the future of public transport — convenient, affordable, connected and zero-emission. Our goal is to make it easier and more enjoyable to get from A to B with Ember than it is with your own car. Ember is a tech company, not a traditional bus operator. We've built a platform that coordinates our entire operation — everything from monitoring vehicles and controlling chargers to selling tickets and calculating ETAs. This allows us to use electric buses more intensively than anyone else in the world, leading to a massive reduction in emissions. It also helps us provide a much better passenger experience, with innovative features like demand-responsive stops. We’re still tiny, with a handful of routes and ~100 buses. The challenge is to scale this 50x whilst staying lean, increasing efficiency and delivering an even better product experience. We’ve recently raised a Series A from some of Europe’s leading climate VCs and are looking for mission-driven individuals who want to get on board and help take us to the next level. The role Charging hubs are Ember's key growth enabler. They give us the ultra-fast charge points we need to run our network, and they act as a base for our fleet — parking, washing, driver lounges and more. We have hubs across Scotland today, with additional sites across the UK under construction or in the pipeline. You'll join a small team of four, taking end-to-end responsibility for your own sites and helping out on others. We're typically running a handful of projects at any one time. Step one is finding a site. You’ll need to think about where we need charging capacity to support

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Ruby on Rails 100 % remote (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Nicht jede gute Software steht im Rampenlicht. Aber sie sorgt dafür, dass Unternehmen jeden Tag zuverlässig arbeiten können. Bei easybill bauen wir Software, die über 27.000 Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen einfacher, schneller und automatisierter zu steuern. E-Rechnung wird Pflicht. E-Commerce wird komplexer. KI verändert, wie gute Software entsteht. Und genau hier setzen wir an. Für unsere E-Commerce-Anwendung easybill Connect suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer Ruby on Rails (w/m/d) , der nicht nur Code schreibt, sondern Verantwortung übernimmt, Systeme versteht und Lust hat, mit KI, Ownership und technischem Anspruch echte Produktwirkung zu erzielen. Wenn du Projekte gerne eigenständig steuerst, komplexe Probleme sauber löst und KI-Tools wie Claude Code nicht als Spielerei, sondern als Produktivitätshebel verstehst: Willkommen bei easybill. Worum es geht? easybill Connect ist unsere zentrale Lösung für e-Commerce-Händler, die Rechnungen, Marktplätze, Shopsysteme, Versandprozesse und steuerliche Anforderungen miteinander verbinden müssen. Die Anwendung wird in Ruby on Rails entwickelt. Unser Stack ist technisch anspruchsvoll und umfasst unter anderem: MySQL / Percona XtraDB Cluster TiDB Elasticsearch Redis MinIO Docker TypeScript React und viele weitere Technologien. jobs.title: Engineering Director (100% Remote within Poland)
jobs.description: Build the AI-native healthcare journey Every month, around 100 million people come to Docplanner to find a doctor, book a visit, stay in touch with their care and pay for it. Each of those steps is now being reinvented with AI. Search is turning into conversation. Booking is becoming something an agent can do for you. Payments that once needed a human to step in are starting to resolve themselves. Ongoing care is moving from reminders to proactive, personal follow-up. We're looking for an Engineering Director to lead that change across Marketplace, Patient Engagement and Payments . It's the part of Docplanner that most patients see and much of what providers depend on. You'll lead around 75 engineers and turn three strong areas into one connected, intelligent patient experience. Our mission is to help people live longer, healthier lives. We use AI to do that in a way that patients and doctors can trust. Why this role, why now Most engineering leaders are still deciding what AI means for their teams. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja , the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.  AI at SharkNinja At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in. Our purpose is to positively impact people s lives every day in every home around the world! We thrive on passion and innovation and are looking for great people, with great ideas, who want to build the next big thing and develop while they do.   The Brand Marketing Manager will play a key role in the regional Ninja marketing team, driving the development and execution of marketing commercialization plans across Central European markets that drive profitable and sustainable growth for the business. jobs.description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Als Junior Operations Specialist sorgst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team dafür, dass unsere operativen Prozesse rund um den Verkaufsprozess reibungslos funktionieren. Du bist eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Vertriebspartnern und verschiedenen internen Teams. Dabei geht es nicht um aktiven Verkauf , sondern darum, operative Fragen zu lösen, Prozesse zu koordinieren und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Partner und internen Teams ihre Arbeit effizient erledigen können. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, tief in unsere Prozesse einzusteigen, Verantwortung für eigene Themen zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Abläufe kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Deine Aufgaben Betreuung und Koordination unserer Vertriebspartner bei operativen Fragen und Herausforderungen im Tagesgeschäft. Direkter Kontakt zu unseren Vertriebspartnern und internen Teams , um Anliegen schnell und lösungsorientiert zu bearbeiten. Bearbeitung und Lösung operativer Cases entlang des Verkaufsprozesses – von der Lead-Übergabe bis zum Verkaufsabschluss und der weiteren Prozessabwicklung. Koordination mit internen Teams , wenn für die Lösung eines Problems weitere Fachbereiche benötigt werden. Monitoring von Prozessen und KPIs , um Abweichungen frühzeitig zu erkennen und mögliche Probleme zu adressieren. Identifikation von Verbes

jobs.title: Head of Change.org, Germany - (snr Communications Manager)
jobs.description: Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Communications Manager to lead our team in Germany, as Head of Change.org , Germany. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. The job also involves being the public voice of Change.org in the German media. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through an exceptional network, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle. We'd welcome ambitious Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role. Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions. What you will achieve Create awareness spikes. Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Earn trust across the political spectrum. Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks into how the team works. Mobilise your network. jobs.title: Senior Software QA Engineer
jobs.description: At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role You will build the platform that transforms raw neuro-signals into longitudinal patient insights, effectively defining the new standard of care in neuro-critical settings. As a Software Test Engineer for the CoVision project, you will be co-responsible for the safety and effectiveness of our medical devices through comprehensive Verification and Validation (V&V) processes. You will work throughout the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), focusing on software and integration testing for both products and internal tools. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Compliance-as-Code: Build workflows that map verification evidence to regulatory standards and generate that evidence automatically. Testing Strategy: Own comprehensive test plans, protocols and execution reports for medical device software. V&V Leadership: Drive formal software verification and validation, ensuring adherence to IEC 62304 (Class C) and ISO 14971. Process Automation: Push test automation, CI/CD pipelines and new testing techniques forward, including LLM-assisted quality gates. Hardware Integration: Work with systems engineers to test multi-tasking systems and signal-processing applications on real hardware. Skills & Experience: 5+ years in software testing, particularly for complex or safety-critical systems. Proficiency in Python. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next. Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out. What you'll own You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ship

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Manager – Quality & Regulatory Affairs / QMB ISO 13485 (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Intro Back problems are the most common reason for inability to work in Germany. Vivira has the solution: digital exercise therapy via app – always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Behind every application permanently listed in the DiGA directory stands a robust quality management system. That is exactly why we are looking for you: As Senior Compliance Manager, you will take on the role of Quality Management Representative (QMB) according to ISO 13485 and keep our medical devices MDR-compliant – from the next audit to the inclusion of further products in the DiGA directory. Your responsibilities include As Senior Compliance Manager (m/f/d), you will be responsible for our quality management system and take on the role of Quality Management Representative according to ISO 13485. You report directly to our Team Lead Compliance and work closely with Engineering and Product. QMS & Regulatory Affairs: You monitor compliance with DiGAV, MDR, ISO 13485, and ISO 27001, contribute to our BSI certification topics, and develop processes, SOPs, and Work Instructions pragmatically and based on risk. Technical Documentation: You create and maintain the Technical Documentation according to MDR (DHF/DMR) for our three medical devices – one app listed in the DiGA directory and two CE-marked products in DiGA studies. Audits: You prepare and follow up on external audits with the notified body, and plan and conduct internal audits. Your first milestone: the ISO 13485 recertification audit in February 2027 – with a stable system, complete documentation, and a planned handover by your predecessor. Releases & Post-Market Surveillance: You review and approve release documentation and are responsible for post-market surveillance of our products. Supplier Management: You evaluate and monitor our software providers (e.g. Atlassian, HubSpot, Google) according to criticality. Regulatory Radar: You evaluate regulatory changes monthly and derive concrete measures.

Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have: Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI. Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily. Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies. The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years

Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world. Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here . About the role You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? jobs.title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
jobs.description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) . Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie. Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken. Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Verder ontwikkelen, inrichten en positioneren van de Chief Privacy Officer-functie. Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie. Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken. Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan. Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen. Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's). Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming. Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen. Wat vragen wij? Eisen Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding op het gebied van gegevensbescherming, privacy of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 2,5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) of plaatsvervangend CPO binnen de Rijksoverheid. Aantoonbare ervaring met de toepassing van privacywetgeving, waaronder de AVG, binnen grote organisaties met meer dan 1.000 medewerke

jobs.title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
jobs.description: À propos de Brixio Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes. L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans. La mission L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans. Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe. Responsabilités Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration). Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security. Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs. jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager | Sweden | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value. Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rathe

jobs.description: Hi there! We are Testlio , a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work. At the moment, we're working with Uber to test new EV charging scenarios within the Uber Driver app — a feature currently being rolled out gradually. We're looking for already registered and active Uber drivers in France who drive an Electric Vehicle to help us ensure this feature works as expected in your region. Your feedback will be valuable in ensuring other drivers have a smooth experience using this new functionality. Device Requirements: iPhone running iOS 26 or above (tablets and iPads are not allowed) To participate in this project, you will need to create an account on our platform. Through this account, we can assign you testing tasks. You will be asked to use our website for defect tracking and will receive materials to prepare you for testing. Payrate: $27 USD/hr You will be paid per hour, not per issue/bug you find. That way, you get paid even if you don't find any bugs. We will reimburse you for any amount spent at charging stations while completing the testing scenarios. You can choose to be paid via PayPal or Payoneer for tasks completed on our website. Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio Schedule : You can create your own schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you. Location : Testlio is a 100% remote company. You can work from anywhere. Growth : You'll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career. Payment : You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. Requirements Age : At least 18 years old. Location : Must be physically located anywhere in France. You must be an existing, active Uber driver. You must own/drive an Electric Vehicle. Availability : Up to 10 hours total — testing may happen across multiple days, not all in one sitting. Cadence

jobs.description: ⚖️ Who are we Plato is building the AI OS for litigation lawyers. With AI, the legal industry is on the verge of a major transformation. Litigation lawyers are overwhelmed by complex and repetitive tasks: complex damage calculations, thousands of documents to review, days spent drafting legal documents, and more. Our mission: Build the leading AI OS for litigation lawyers , enabling professionals to work 5x faster , by putting their whole firm on autopilot. Plato already supports more than 30 law firms and 1 major insurance company’s legal team, who use our solution daily to manage hundreds of active cases. Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding. Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals. 🎯 Your mission You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product . Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production systems . You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs. Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique ! jobs.title: Stage – Développement de projets de stockage d’energie par batteries (BESS) (F/H/X)
jobs.description: Localisation Poste basé à Avignon (84). Vous souhaitez découvrir concrètement comment se développent les projets de stockage par batteries et contribuer à la transition énergétique ? Au sein de l’équipe Novar en France, vous serez accompagné·e par les équipes de développement et les supports techniques. Vous participerez, à votre niveau, à l’identification de sites et à la préparation des premières analyses et démarches d’autorisation pour des projets de stockage. Vous accompagnerez également dans leurs missions de développement de projets solaires les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets et les Chef.fe .s de projets. Vos missions · Identification de sites pour des projets de stockage par batteries. Pour cela, un travail d’analyse et de suivi des évolutions techniques et réglementaires devra être réalisé. · Analyses et prédimensionnement du projet de stockage sur la base des informations collectées (caractéristiques du réseau électrique à proximité ; règles d’urbanismes ; enjeux liés à l’occupation du sol, aux accès, au voisinage et aux zonages environnementaux). · Préparer des supports de synthèse (recherches documentaires, cartographie et tableaux de suivi) et apprendre à faire ressortir les principaux points à approfondir. · Accompagner les Chef.fe .s de projet en Développement et les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets dans leurs missions et se familiariser avec les démarches de sécurisation foncière, de développement de projets et de permitting sous leurs supervisions. Votre profil · Bac +5 type Master ou Ingénieur généraliste ou énergie . · Un intérêt marqué pour les énergies renouvelables, les systèmes électriques et la transition énergétique. · À l’aise avec la recherche, l’analyse et la synthèse d’informations, ainsi qu’avec la rédaction de documents clairs. · Rigueur, autonomie, curiosité et esprit d’équipe. · Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques ; la connaissance des outils SIG ou de la réglementation en urbanisme et en environnement constitue un plus. · Bon niveau

Remboursements clients, facturation, suivi de la trésorerie ou fiabilité des données : tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au contact de l’équipe et des demandes du quotidien. En tant que stagiaire FinOps , tu seras accompagné·e par Valent, Head of Finance, et Ryo, Team Lead Finance , pour apprendre progressivement à gérer les opérations financières. L’objectif collectif : ne laisser aucun ticket ouvert à la fin de la semaine ; Fiabiliser nos données : identifier et corriger les incohérences pour disposer de données financières fiables et à jour ; Participer aux opérations financières : contribuer à la facturation clients, au suivi de la trésorerie et au paiement des fournisseurs ; Contribuer au reporting : participer à la préparation des reportings et à la réalisation d’analyses simples pour accompagner le suivi de l’activité ; Découvrir d’autres sujets Finance : selon ta progression, participer aux échanges avec le cabinet comptable et les auditeurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de nos processus grâce aux outils no-code ou à l’IA. Un accompagnement dès le premier jour : tu découvriras nos outils, nos processus et les bons réflexes avec l’appui de Ryo ; Une montée en compétences progressive : tu apprendras à comprendre les demandes

jobs.title: Administrateur Systèmes, Réseaux & Cloud (F/H)
jobs.description: À propos de nous E-Finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans la gestion financière et la trésorerie. Nos solutions aident les entreprises à optimiser leurs flux financiers et à gagner en visibilité sur leur trésorerie. Nous les déployons en SaaS et en on-premise chez nos clients, avec de forts enjeux de sécurité et de disponibilité. Nous sommes en pleine phase de modernisation : refonte technique de nos produits historiques, nouvelles fonctionnalités, montée en puissance de nos stacks. Dans une équipe à taille humaine, c’est le bon moment pour laisser une vraie empreinte. Le poste Rattaché(e) au responsable R&D et IT, vous êtes la personne de référence sur l’infrastructure et l’IT de l’entreprise. Vous partagez votre temps entre le quotidien et les sujets de fond. Au quotidien Gérer les arrivées et départs : postes, comptes, accès Gérer les accès et les échanges de fichiers sécurisés avec nos clients (SFTP, FTPS, listes blanches) Assurer l’assistance aux utilisateurs et appuyer le support sur les questions d’infrastructure de nos clients en on-premise Administrer Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, DNS et certificats Superviser les systèmes, gérer sauvegardes, mises à jour et patching Être l’interlocuteur du groupe pour les sujets Microsoft 365 et le relais auprès de nos prestataires IT Pour faire avancer l’entreprise Faire évoluer et optimiser nos environnements cloud et Microsoft (Azure, Entra ID) : sécurité, coûts, bonnes pratiques Automatiser les tâches récurrentes et documenter l’existant Renforcer la sécurité : durcissement des postes et serveurs, suivi des vulnérabilités, réponse aux incidents Contribuer à la conformité (ISO 27001, RGPD), aux réponses aux questionnaires de sécurité et aux audits de nos clients Assurer une veille technologique et proposer des améliorations continues Votre profil Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en administration systèmes et réseaux Très bonne connaissance de Windows Server et d’Active Directory Connaissances Lin

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description: Who we are Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies. The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. Comand AI is at the forefront of the rebuilding of these verticals to serve our countries resilience. Comand AI core product is a next generation command and control software platform, which allows militaries to operate at machine speed in a communication and GNSS denied context. A few facts to anchor you: €45M raised from seed to Series A, Blossom Capital leading the series A and Saab as a strategic investor Software platform combat proven and deployed in Ukraine A lean team of operators with backgrounds from Palantir, OpenAI and world-class tech experience, alongside unique expertise from the defense sector Live business with governments and defense industry leaders across Europe Paris (HQ), London, Munich and Kyiv subsidiaries The Role You'd join the engineering team to own features end to end, with a strong lean toward the interfaces and workflows clients interact with directly. This is a product engineering role. Unlike our Forward Deployed Engineers, you are not embedded with clients or responsible for running deployments in the field. You turn operational needs and field feedback into a durable core product. What this looks like in practice: Own end-to-end features on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from scoping and interaction choices through backend implementation and production Spend significant time on the front end, building clear, reliable workflows for users working with complex information under pressure Solve real geospatial problems: move data between backend and frontend

As the Category Manager for Packaging, you will report directly to the Director of Packaging and take full ownership of creating and developing our Primary packaging category (ingredient packaging, plastic film…). Develop the Supply Base : Build and maintain a strong pool of primary packaging suppliers capable of providing all of our ingredient packaging requirements, taking full ownership of vendor selection, specs definition, KPIs and relationships. jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Agency
jobs.description: The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.  Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly. The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you. The Trade Desk is changing the way global brands and their agencies advertise to audiences around the world. How? With a media buying platform that helps brands deliver a more insightful and relevant ad experience for consumers, and sets a new standard for global reach, accuracy, and transparency. We are proud of the culture we have built.
